entries.en: Notrelchamps has a message for you from an old friend.
entries.fr: Notrelchamps a un message confidentiel à vous transmettre.
entries.ja: イシュガルド・ランディングのノトレルシャンは、冒険者に伝えたいことがあるようだ。

entries.en: Notrelchamps informs you that your erstwhile companion Wedge is looking for you to assist in some top secret project of the utmost urgency. Seek the small fellow out at the Aetherochemical Research Facility in Azys Lla and see what could possibly be so important.
entries.fr: Notrelchamps vous a fait savoir que Wedge avait besoin de vous parler. Retrouvez-le près de l'entrée du Laboratoire de magismologie, à Azys Lla.
entries.ja: ノトレルシャンに、ウェッジからの伝言を聞いた。アジス・ラーの魔科学研究所の入口にいる「ウェッジ」と話そう。

entries.en: You meet Wedge at the Aetherochemical Research Facility, where he reveals the nature of his project. The ever-emotional youth seeks to restore life to “Gilly,” the helpful guidance node who showed you about in your travels through Azys Lla. To that end, he entreats you to travel to the Fractal Continuum─a museum of Allagan technology housed inside a decommissioned warship─and come back with a new node nacelle, into which Gilly's “heart” might be transferred. Venture to Matter Conduit VI-VII and access the teleporter there.

entries.fr: Il se trouve que le Lalafell cherche un moyen de ressusciter la sphère de guidage qui vous a accompagné tout au long de votre périple à Azys Lla. Il pense avoir découvert un endroit où pourrait se trouver une unité centrale de remplacement, une sorte de musée appelé Le Continuum fractal. Pour vous y rendre, utilisez le téléporteur du transfert de matière VI-VII.
entries.ja: ウェッジに、機能停止した「誘導システム」の新しい基板を探すよう頼まれた。博物戦艦「フラクタル・コンティニアム」にあるかもしれないという。アジス・ラーの第VI転送リングの「アラグの転送装置」を調べよう。

entries.en:
You successfully locate the teleporter that will grant you access to the Fractal Continuum, which issues you a warning regarding security clearance and anti-intruder systems that bodes ill for your impending visit. Ignore it and brave whatever awaits within, that Gilly might live on.

※The Fractal Continuum can be accessed via the Duty Finder.

entries.en: You have triumphed over the chimerical horrors that inhabited the Fractal Continuum to emerge with a top-of-the-line nacelle that will serve as a new body for Wedge's favorite guidance node. Take pride in the fact that you've done right by Gilly, and deliver the nacelle to the Lalafellin engineer back at the Aetherochemical Research Facility.

entries.en: Gilly's new body works like a charm, and Wedge rejoices at being reunited with his friend. He then entrusts the guidance node to you, that she might accompany you on your adventures and see that there is more to the world than the aetheric wastes she has known for the past five thousand years. Go forth with your loyal new accompaniment node at your side!
entries.fr: Grâce à vous, Wedge est aux anges car la nouvelle unité centrale a permis à la sphère de guidage de reprendre conscience. À votre tour de lui faire voir du pays en l'emmenant partout avec vous !
entries.ja: 新しい基板を得た「誘導システム」は、無事に蘇ったようだ。誘導システムとともに世界を周り、世の中には沢山の人がいて、ひとりぼっちではないということを教えてあげよう。

entries.en: I was feeling awfully lonely without her, so I snuck out the back door when the chief wasn't looking.

entries.en: Doesn't it just break your heart, ? Left alone in this wasteland for thousands of years, just waiting for someone to help, and as soon as she's done her duty─clunk! Tossed to the side like a rusty old suit of armor!

entries.fr: J'ai trouvé ça tellement gentil de sa part que je n'avais pas envie de la laisser moisir toute seule ici... Je vais plutôt faire tout mon possible pour la réactiver, ouais !

entries.en: At first I had a mind to fix her up myself, but I fear she's proven beyond my abilities to repair. That's when I hit upon it─if we found a new body for Gilly, we could transfer her personality and memories right into it! It'd be like she'd never left!
entries.fr: Pour faire simple, si on arrive à faire passer son esprit dans un nouveau corps, notre gentille boule devrait pouvoir retrouver une nouvelle jeunesse, héhé !

新しいまっさらな「身体」に移してやるってことッス！

entries.en: I know what you're thinking─and just where are we going to find this new body, Wedge? I've got three words for you: the Fractal Continuum! It's an old warship that was converted into a museum of Allagan technology.
entries.fr: En examinant de plus près la carte des environs, j'ai remarqué qu'il y avait une sorte de musée au sud d'ici. Apparemment, il s'appelle “Le Continuum fractal”.

ここからずっと南に行ったところに、あることがわかったッス。

entries.en: I've got a favor to ask you, . This might sound silly, but I want you to take Gilly with you on your adventures. I want her to see that there's more to our world than this aetheric waste she's called home for thousands of years.

entries.en: Yes, I'd say our little girl's done enough guidance. From this day forward, she's an accompaniment node─and with you, she's going to go where no node has gone before!
entries.fr: Elle est des nôtres maintenant, alors il faut lui montrer du pays et lui présenter plein de gens ! Ça la changera des siècles de solitude à Azys Lla, héhé !
entries.ja:

ひとりじゃないって、わからせてやってほしいッス！！
